```{r error handling, message=NA}
message("Received rank parameter:", params$rank, "\n")
if(is.null(params$rank) || params$rank == "") {
  stop("Rank parameter is empty or not set")
}
```

```{r libraries}
library(rgbif)
library(readr)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r build query path, message=NA}
rank <- params$rank

cat(rank)

query <- paste0("./data/interim/cube_queries/griis_belgium_", tolower(rank), "_query.txt")

message(query)
```

```{r check query}
if(!file.exists(query)){
  stop(paste(getwd(), query, " does not exist"))
}
```

```{r read query}
query <- query %>% 
  readLines() 
```

```{r FUN: countdown_sleep}
countdown_sleep <- function(sleep_time) {
  message(paste("Sleeping for", sleep_time, "seconds"))
  
  for (i in sleep_time:1) {
    cat("\rTime remaining:", i, " seconds")
    Sys.sleep(1)
  }
  
  message("\nDone sleeping => recalculating status\n")
}
```

```{r halt execution if too many active downloads, message=NA}
num_active_downloads <- "--init--" 
# set to --init-- to trigger the while loop
# and to stagger the downloads

while(num_active_downloads >= 3 | num_active_downloads == "--init--"){
  
  message(paste("Number of active downloads:", num_active_downloads))
  
  if(rank == "SPECIES"){
    sleep_time <- 20
  }
  
  if(rank == "SUBSPECIES_FORM_VARIETY"){
    sleep_time <- 45
  }
  
  if(rank == "GENUS"){
    sleep_time <- 70
  }
  
  if(rank == "FAMILY"){
    sleep_time <- 90
  }
  
  if(num_active_downloads >= 3 | num_active_downloads == "--init--"){
    # downloads are staggered to avoid overloading the GBIF API
    # longest lists are triggered first to avoid long waiting times
    countdown_sleep(sleep_time)
    
    # Get list of all downloads
    downloads <- occ_download_list(user = Sys.getenv("gbif_user"),
                                   pwd = Sys.getenv("gbif_pwd"))
    
    downloads <- as.data.frame(downloads)
    
    # Filter for active downloads (status is RUNNING or PREPARING)
    active_downloads <- downloads[downloads$results.status %in% c("RUNNING", "PREPARING"), ]
    
    # Get the count of active downloads
    num_active_downloads <- nrow(active_downloads)
    
  }
  
}

if(num_active_downloads < 3){
  message(paste("Number of active downloads:", num_active_downloads))
  message("initiating download")
}
```

```{r initiate download}
cube <- occ_download_sql(q = query, 
                         format = "SQL_TSV_ZIP",
                         email = Sys.getenv("email"),
                         user = Sys.getenv("gbif_user"),
                         pwd = Sys.getenv("gbif_pwd"))
```

```{r create cube_data folder}
if(!dir.exists("./cube_data")){
  dir.create("./cube_data")
}
```

```{r download cube}
occ_download_wait(cube)

occ_download_get(cube, overwrite = TRUE) %>%
  occ_download_import() %>% 
  write_csv(file = paste0("./cube_data/be_alientaxa_cube_", rank, ".csv"))
```
